title: fix(fields): line-item grid stores an emptied multi-record lookup cell as null, reads names once per object, mutes an empty list
body:
Fixes #36552
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 编辑带明细行表格的记录时(控制台里人员列、多选查找列),清空多选查找格现在存为空值而不是空列表;二十行的人员列从二十次读取变成一次;列表模式下空列表的破折号变灰。
- 属于明细行表格(多选、标签、人员单元格)那一批工作的收尾,替上次评审留下的四个非阻塞项收口。
- 若出错,碰到的是明细行表格里人员和查找列的名字显示或清空后的存值;改动只在表格组件内,可直接撤回这一个合并。
- 无。

Opened for `repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmNmMEXS4EzeVz9RjvD` (area s2-A).

## What changes

The editable line-item grid (`@object-ui/fields`, `GridFieldWidget`), the four items of #36552:

1. **An emptied multi-record lookup cell writes `null`.** The lookup cell's `onChange` now goes through `emptyListAsNull`, the helper the multi-select, tags and people cells already use. Measured on `origin/main` at `e7399fcdb` before the change: un-picking the last record of a `lookup` column with `multiple: true` wrote `[{"products":[]}]`.
2. **Names are read once per referenced object, not once per line.** Measured on `origin/main` at `e7399fcdb`: twenty lines with a `user` column and a `lookup` column (naming two products) made **20 `findOne` on `sys_user` and 20 on `product`**, 0 `find`. Each cell is its own `LookupField`, whose hydration reads its one bare id with `findOne`.
   The grid now hands every people and lookup cell it draws (editable cell, the people cell's resting face and panel, the read-only table, list mode) a data source from the new `grid-field/lineReferenceReads.ts`: the page's source, with the plain by-id read (`findOne(object, id)`, no options) gathered per tick into one `find(object, { $filter: { id: { $in: ids } } })` per object, ids de-duplicated, at most 50 ids per read (`LookupField`'s own `$in` page size). Every other member, and a by-id read carrying options, passes to the page's source unchanged (bound to it). Same grid after the change: **1 `$in` read of `sys_user` (20 ids), 1 of `product` (2 ids), 0 `findOne`**, in editable, read-only and list mode.
   **Why not `$expand` on the child read (Prime Directive 5, SQL first):** the grid does not make that read. Its rows arrive as a value: from `MasterDetailForm`'s and `LineItemsPanel`'s reads of the child object (both in `@object-ui/plugin-form`, outside this card's file surface), or stored inline as the `grid` field's JSON, where no `$expand` reaches the ids inside. An expanded reference in a row is also what the save diff and the blank-line check would read and send back. One `$in` read per object is one SQL `IN` query, at the one place every host's rows pass through.
3. **The multi-person cell's `null` on Clear is pinned** (it was right by reading).
4. **Display leftovers.** `cellDisplayText`'s `multiselect` arm loses its unreachable empty-list return (the guard at the top already answers an empty list with the em dash). In list mode the muted class reads `isEmptyCell`, so a stored `[]` draws the em dash muted, as `null` and `''` did.

Changeset: `.changeset/36552-line-item-grid-followups.md`, patch for `@object-ui/fields`.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/lineReferenceReads.ts`: the `Proxy` around the page data source, and `flush` (chunking, de-duplication, rows keyed by `id` else `_id` as `LookupField`'s own `$in` read keys them, `null` for an id the read did not return, rejection fan-out).
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx`: the `cellSource` line and the `dataSource={cellSource}` props on the five cell sites; the lookup `onChange` hunk.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx`: the pins, one top-level describe at the end of the file (`line-item grid follow-ups: ... (objectstack#36552)`).

## Tests

Seven pins in one top-level describe at the end of `GridField.test.tsx` (moved there from a separate file once #36607 landed, per ruling record 6583487846; names and assertions unchanged): multi-record lookup un-pick writes `null`; multi-person Clear writes `null`; one `$in` read per object and zero `findOne` with all 20 names drawn, in editable, read-only and list mode; a backend answering with `_id` only still draws each name from the one read; list-mode `[]` multi-select and tags cells draw the muted em dash.

<details><summary>Package runs at head fbdfc7d4f (after merging origin/main at ed0edb1b5, which brought #36607)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): clean.
- `GridField.test.tsx` + `GridField.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 140 passed (140)`; the seven pins alone (`-t 36552`): `Tests 7 passed`.
- Earlier, at 2431b1b9b, the whole package: `Test Files 323 passed | 1 skipped (324)`, `Tests 4897 passed | 7 skipped (4904)`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one leg per pinned behaviour, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored and proven)</summary>

The subject is imported by relative path from source, so no `dist/` is involved. Each leg: anchor x1 to x0, blob changed, run, restore with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- lookup `onChange` without `emptyListAsNull`: the multi-record lookup pin fails, 1 failed / 5 passed.
- people `onWrite` without `emptyListAsNull`: the multi-person pin fails, 1 failed / 5 passed.
- `cellSource` forced to `undefined` (cells read the page source directly): the three one-read pins fail, 3 failed / 3 passed.
- list-mode muted test back to `null`/`''`: the muted pin fails, 1 failed / 5 passed.
- (at fbdfc7d4f) rows keyed by `id` only: `× a backend that answers with _id only`, 1 failed / 6 passed.

The first four legs ran while the pins were in their own file; the moved pins are byte-identical in name and assertion.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Test placement.** The pins first lived in their own file because open PR #36607 edited `GridField.test.tsx`; #36607 has merged, so they now sit in `GridField.test.tsx` as one top-level describe (ruling record 6583487846), and the separate file is deleted.
- **Reads that still go per cell.** A by-id read with options, a lookup column whose `idField` is not `id` (`LookupField` reads those with `find` on an equality filter, not `findOne`), and an id the batched read did not return (deleted or unreadable; the cell's own read gets the same answer). Out of the card's shape; noted, not changed.
- **README / docs.** No sentence in `ui/packages/fields/README.md` or `content/docs/frontend/` describes the per-line read, the stored `[]` or the muted class, so none was made false; none edited.
- **Seen while measuring, not changed:** a `lookup` column with `multiple: true` reads `undefined` in read-only and list mode (the two read-only `LookupField` sites pass no `multiple`), while the editable cell reads `2 selected`. Reported to the seat.

## Verification

Two minutes: from `ui/`, run `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields exec vitest run --root ../.. -t 36552 packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx`. Expect `Tests 7 passed`, the rest of the file skipped.

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 38 families at 2b1bd4490 and the same 38 at fbdfc7d4f; all 38 ran locally with exit 0 at each head (`--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all with exit codes). Everything else is CI's.
